publication_status: W3C Working Draft; not a Recommendation
use: Opt-in forward-looking research, design critique and gap discovery; never as 2.x conformance requirements.
prohibited: No WCAG 3.0 compliance or certification assertions
Do not substitute draft requirements for an applicable WCAG 2.1 or 2.2 criterion
Do not silently treat proposed conformance tiers as finalized

themes.analysis: Examine wearables, interactive and immersive experiences, streaming content and authoring tools, beyond ordinary web page screenshots.
Describe the user need and observable result rather than scoring success by having implemented a particular technique.
Distinguish draft requirements from draft assertions and informative methods; do not convert explanatory examples into mandates.
Track changes to scope, evaluation, evidence and reporting tiers without building production certification around the draft.
Flag potential accessibility gaps for future investigation; pair each recommendation with its draft source and status.
